name: Saber Arena ⚔️ [Ranked Duels]
desc:
⚔️ Fight with sabers! Defeat players, unlock new lightsabers, and use awesome force powers!

💰 Defeat players to earn credits
🔓 Unlock new sabers, rare crystals, and cosmetics
⚔️ Combat inspired by Combat Warriors, The Strongest Battlegrounds, and Battlefront II
💜 Like and favorite the game to support development
👾 Join the group for future rewards and updates

🎮 Platform Support
PC 💻 | Tablet 📱| Console 🎮
(Xbox & PlayStation supported)

👍 Enjoying the game?
Leave a thumbs-up, it helps a lot!

⚠️ NOTICE:
Cheating, exploiting, or farming with alts will result in a permanent ban.
